title: Simultaneous Laminations
summary: Calegari introduced the laminations $Λ^\pm_u$ associated to a universal circle. We study the laminations $Λ^\pm_u$ for pseudo-Anosov orbit space universal circles of taut foliations, on atoroidal three-manifolds. We prove that $Λ^+_u$ and $Λ^-_u$ are completely determined by the stable and unstable prelaminations on the boundary of the orbit space.
